lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a semi-regular grid distribution across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like anchor node pattern across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and lower intensity/shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral surface of the first dorsal fin displays a low-to-moderate density of high-luminance circular blobs distributed across its silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora is visible attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
